verdict.rationale: Tavily produces AI-generated synthesis. Research builds multi-search analyzed reports, qna_search returns concise answers, and crawl accepts natural-language instructions over user-specified sites. All of this runs on public web content through an API, not as insights or suggestions drawn from the user's own data inside a product interface. Missing for 10: insights over the user's own or private data, an in-product insights/suggestions surface, proactive suggestions, independent or hands-on corroboration.
